name: MAAYA RAJESHWARAN REVATHI
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: An aggressive baseliner with a powerful forehand and mature court sense, drawing comparisons to Serena Williams.
Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #850 (March 24, 2025), Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: Unranked.
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a senior Grand Slam main draw; qualified for 2025 Australian Open Juniors.
Notable Achievements: WTA Debut: Reached SF at 2025 WTA 125 Mumbai Open as a wildcard, defeating World No. 225 Iryna Shymanovich and No. 285 Mei Yamaguchi. Junior Success: Won J300 Delhi (2025), reaching ITF Junior Top 60, and secured 5 junior singles titles (2023-2024). National Titles: 2024 Fenesta National Championship runner-up (lost to Vaidehi Chaudhari). Other Highlights: Secured a one-year scholarship to Rafa Nadal Academy (2024) after a trial in Mallorca. Youngest Indian to earn a WTA point (2025). Aims to win a junior Grand Slam in 2025.
Maaya is India’s brightest tennis prodigy, poised for a breakout pro career. 🎾🇮🇳
